description: A 4 x 2 face-on extinction map at 8 bits, pinned from both languages. log10_mag is the raw map of log10 A(V) in magnitudes, row by row from the top, null for a pixel with no dust; every value is exact as an f32. Quantising it (floor = log10 of 0.01 mag = -2, ceiling = its maximum) gives codes, which map encodes.
